detail: Later reporting says teachers were on strike since December 2020; exact onset date, participation count and any public gathering in December are unspecified. This retrospective does not support zero/no-event inference.
A Jan 8 student march is reported but headcount absent; it is outside the assigned month. Dec 16 announcement concerns Jan 4–8 strike. No Q4 gathering threshold can be inferred from either.

Four week-window and regional/language searches were conducted, but regional coverage beyond Bissau and body-verified December protest actions remain limited. Exact-target helper access-check was not preserved for Dec body open; prebody assessment is retained and the process gap remains.
